facts.note: Husband had everyone show watches when the temple struck nine; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine; Aurèle scolded him.
When the temple struck ten, she looked at the salon clock, which showed five minutes to ten.
She and the doctor played piquet in the salon without a break until he went out for his cigars, leaving at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
As he left he asked her to play; she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after his return, the hall clock struck eleven.
